key_not_required: {program} does not require its key ({variable}): this version of llama.cpp does not read it, so it would be open to every program on this machine. It has been stopped: update the engine.
not_on_phone: On the phone, AIODOS does not borrow graphics cards: it cannot check which program connects to the tunnel to the lent card.
llama_not_installed: llama.cpp is not installed on this machine (setting “llama.cpp folder”).
companion_not_running: The aiodos-net companion is not running: it connects the machines of the group (setting “Connect my machines over the Internet”).
no_lender: None of my machines is lending its graphics card right now (setting “Lend my graphics card” on them).
setup_interrupted: Setup of the split model interrupted.
loading_on: Loading {model} on {machines} machines: the first time, the weights travel over the network, then each machine keeps them…
tunnel_not_reserved: The aiodos-net companion could not reserve the tunnel for llama-server: {error}
not_responding: The split model is no longer responding: a machine of the group may have left. Try again, it will be set up again.
wont_start: The split model could not start: try again later.
companion_not_running_here: The aiodos-net companion is not running on this machine (setting “Connect my machines over the Internet”).
lend_off: “{name}” does not lend its graphics card (setting “Lend my graphics card for large models”).
mine_only: Only my machines can borrow this graphics card.
phone_does_not_lend: “{name}” is a phone: it does not lend its computing power to large models split across machines.
update_borrower: Update AIODOS on “{name}”: its version would open the tunnel to this graphics card to every program on the machine.
net_key_unknown: Your machine's Internet key is unknown here: both sides need the aiodos-net companion.
versions_differ: Different llama.cpp versions: {version} on “{name}”, {yours} on your side.
no_card_on: No graphics card to lend on “{name}”.
companion_too_old: The aiodos-net companion on “{name}” is too old to lend its card, or cannot guard it on this system: update AIODOS on “{name}”.
rpc_failed: Could not start the RPC server on “{name}”: {error}
companion_refused: The companion refused to open the card: {error}
digest_unreadable: Unreadable file checksum in Ollama's manifest.
no_weights_file: The model “{name}” has no readable weights file.
not_gguf: This file is not in GGUF format.
